title: Book 8 DRILL: whole book
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 8 · 8 questions · 81 marks · every stem a real exam question · all nine outcomes, (a) to (i)
los_html: Every question here is a real exam paper question at its own mark allocation, lifted as the paper sets it, with its verbatim mark scheme. Every stem is a real prelim or specimen question at its own mark allocation, including two Section B essays. Between them they cover all nine outcomes, (a) to (i). A note under each mark scheme says which outcomes it carries and why that question was chosen. Read 1a - STUDY SHEET - Book 8 first.
